title: Through the middle
tip: Look at the runners before the ball comes to you, so the pass is ready in your head.

options.text: Play it short to the side
options.why: It keeps the ball, but you missed a run that could have gone through.

options.text: Slide it through for the run
options.why: The look showed a mate running between two opponents, with room beyond. Play it into their path.

options.text: Hit it long over the top
options.why: Too long for the run, so the keeper comes out and collects it.

scan.prompt: You've got the ball in midfield. Have a look before your next pass.
